legend.load_seconds: seconds the search waited for the model to load
legend.n_cpu_moe: layers whose MoE experts stay in system RAM (null: no such flag)
legend.order: the predeclared settings, tried in this order until one loads and answers a canary request
legend.status: FIT: loaded and answered the canary; NO_FIT: did not load or did not answer
legend.tensor_split: the -ts value: share of the layers per card (null: no such flag)

legend.budget_exhausted: times the server log shows the reasoning budget forcing the end of the reasoning block
legend.budget_reached: the harness's flag: estimated reasoning at 90 % of the budget or more, or an answer cut at the cap
legend.budget_reopened: times the server log shows the model re-opening its reasoning after such a closure
legend.format_bad: answers the checker could not read
legend.mean_tokens: mean output tokens per answer, reasoning included
legend.reasoning_separated: answers whose reasoning the server returned apart from the visible answer
legend.thinking_leaked: answers whose reasoning appeared in the visible answer (the harness's count)
legend.truncated: answers stopped at the output cap
